name: Login Approval
description: Second factor for Team Edition: users without TOTP approve each new sign-in from a link emailed to them.

settings_schema.header: Users with TOTP multi-factor authentication turned on sign in as usual. Everyone else approves each sign-in from a link emailed to them, then signs in again from the same IP address and browser.

settings.help_text: How long an emailed link stays valid, and how long an approved sign-in waits to be used. Default 15.
At most one approval email per user in this many minutes. Sign-in attempts inside that time are rejected without another email. Default 2.
Comma-separated usernames that sign in with only a password. Leave empty for none.
